entities.summary: Prince Joachim Viktor Wilhelm Leopold Friedrich Sigismund of Prussia was a German World War I fighter pilot and member of the House of Hohenzollern as the son of Prince Friedrich Leopold of Prussia and Princess Louise Sophie of Schleswig-Holstein-Sonderburg-Augustenburg.
